mainEntity.name: When should I choose selective demolition instead of rebuilding from scratch?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need selective demolition when you plan to alter an interior layout, update finishes, or remediate localized damage without rebuilding the entire structure. Common scenarios include removing a non-structural wall to open a kitchen, stripping water-damaged drywall without tearing out framing, or converting commercial office partitions to an open-plan layout. Choosing selective removal over total gutting preserves functional infrastructure and keeps overall project timelines shorter.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose selective demolition when you want to change specific layouts or finishes, like removing a wall or old cabinetry, while leaving sound structural framing and utilities intact.
